item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Donalds focuses on affordability as Republican rivals scramble for momentum
item.description: With fewer than three weeks remaining before Florida’s primary, the Republican race for governor is producing new ads, dueling polls and increasingly pointed attacks—but little evidence that the contest has tightened at the top.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Spain deploys military to Ceuta after thousands of migrants cross from Morocco
item.description: Spain will deploy its military to restore order at its border with Morocco in Ceuta after thousands of migrants streamed into the tiny Spanish territory, with at least nine dying in the attempt.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Advice for families on how to calm back to school anxiety
item.description: School starts for many across the Tampa Bay area the week of August 10. So, if you or your child feels a bit anxious already you are not alone.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Displaced residents from Bradenton assisted living facility continue to wait for a return
item.description: On Thursday the City of Bradenton released a statement detailing everything Aviata at Bradenton assisted living facility needs to do before residents can return following a partial roof collapse.
